sketch:
Observe: SVG schematic with a battery, switch, and a resistor R
(slider). Ammeter A in series and voltmeter V across R. Sliders:
E (battery EMF), R (Ω). On closing the switch, meters display I, U
instantly (DC steady state). HUD also shows P = U·I (W) and, if a
duration slider Δt is set, W = P·Δt (J). Student varies R and
observes P = U²/R = R·I². Experiment: reach a target P (e.g., make a
60 W bulb glow correctly under 12 V) by picking R. Evaluate: meters
hidden; student sets R blind, then closes switch to reveal readings.
Wrinkle: steady-state only (no transient) — reinforces P = U·I is
instantaneous while W is integrated over time.
